description: Every reply the SDK generates to a request line that parsed with method HEAD is head-only, including a head-parse error (MCPWARP.md §4.5): HEAD \mcp is an unsupported request target form (§4.2: origin-form or absolute-form only, checked before the path rule, so 400 and not 404), answered with the head of the 400 {"error":"unsupported request target form"} reply and no body.
in:
HEAD \mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
out:
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 43
notes: Content-Length is the length the body would have had; no body bytes follow it. The same holds for 431 and every other §4.2 400 once the request line parsed as HEAD.
